Medipal Holdings Corporation
is a major Japanese healthcare, beauty, and food distribution holding company. Rather than focusing on a single specific consumer brand or manufacturer, it acts as a massive supply-chain bridge, distributing thousands of
prescription drugs, medical devices, cosmetics, OTC items, and animal health products from hundreds of domestic and global manufacturers to hospitals, pharmacies, and retailers

Prescription and Ethical Pharmaceuticals
Distributes ethical prescription drugs, specialized pharmaceuticals, and rare/orphan drugs.

Cosmetics, Daily Necessities, and OTC Drugs
Operates via its major subsidiary
Paltac Corporation
to distribute over-the-counter (OTC) medicines, cosmetics, and household daily necessities.
Sells consumer goods and general wellness items produced by major Japanese consumer product companies, including key shareholders and partners like
Kobayashi Pharmaceutical Co., Ltd.
to retailers, drugstores, and convenience stores.

Animal Health and Food Ingredients

MP Gokyo Food & Chemical
